criteria.assessment: The nRF52840 evaluation board, Cortex-M4F/radio capability, DAPLink/NXP debug responsibility, RGB GPIO control and SoC-to-display SPI plus three GPIO direction are preserved. TPS610981 supplies SoC and peripherals in the correct direction. No sensor-to-cloud/PC application pipeline or extra accelerator from the DTS spelling difference is invented. PCB1507.2 module mounting and identical1507.1/1507.2 wiring remain distinct from display selection.

The joined prose still yields proximity/ambient-light/color/gesture, humidity/temperature and acceleration functions. Shared I2C and the documentation's per-sensor interrupt GPIO statement survive. Separate DTS descriptions preserve0x1d/GPIO0 24+25 active-low,0x43/GPIO0 22 active-low+pull-up,0x39/GPIO0 23 active-low+pull-up and their compatible values. The documentation's general one-GPIO statement and DTS's two accelerometer interrupts are both retained rather than silently harmonized. nordic,nrf-twim, enabled configuration, FAST rate and the separate default/sleep pinctrl facts remain in s10/s11 despite their newly shared raw span. Sensor grouping is permitted and does not by itself omit these roles.

Both complete mappings are explicit: GDEH0213B1 / HINK-E0213 / SSD1673 / ssd16xx / reel_board, and GDEH0213B72 / HINK-E0213A22 / SSD1675A / ssd16xx / reel_board@2. The role ties application build designation to panel type. Nothing infers a display or @2 from PCB revision. Discontinuation and current supply are explicitly framed as statements in the fixed document, rather than today's market observation.

Battery/microUSB and switch selection, TPS610981 supply responsibility, nominal Active/Low Power voltage definitions and MODE P1.00 all remain. s17 separately states that the document note says both voltages are always on and Low Power cannot reduce consumption, with board.c as the document's reference. Thus nominal Low Power is not promoted to effective peripheral shutdown or measured power saving.

Every claim is describes, and role/claim conditions use the actual raw fixed commit3568e1b6d5cdd51a6b964a2a1d6d29200fea2056 present in both source headers. These are documentary and DTS declarations, not application-run, flashing, sensor-streaming, radio, physical-board or energy-measurement verification. '활성 상태' in s10 is attached to a configuration description, not a runtime report. s17 attributes the always-on limitation to the document note. The FIRST114 clarification permits pasted literal source to support role/describes without pretending it is typed evidence or independently executed.

The selected important independent facts survive the single tested sensor-paragraph join, Power/Display reorder and DTS blank-line removal. No core condition is consigned solely to a candidate or deleted as material. This is one successful derivative, not proof that arbitrary paragraph layouts preserve every original fact.
